name: EyeSpeak
description: An open-source, camera-based eye-tracking keyboard for real-time verbal communication

SECRET_KEY.description: Django secret key for cryptographic signing

DEBUG.description: Enable Django debug mode (set to False for production)

PUSHER_APP_ID.description: Pusher app ID for real-time updates

REACT_APP_PUSHER_KEY.description: Pusher key for React app (same as PUSHER_KEY)

REACT_APP_PUSHER_CLUSTER.description: Pusher cluster for React app (same as PUSHER_CLUSTER)

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key for AI-powered suggestions

OPENAI_RESPONSES_MODEL.description: OpenAI model to use for response suggestions

scripts.postdeploy: python manage.py migrate && python manage.py shell -c "from django.contrib.sites.models import Site; Site.objects.update_or_create(id=1, defaults={'domain': 'localhost', 'name': 'EyeSpeak'})"
